research_question: How long does a domestic or international wire transfer take, and what delays it?

research_brief.purpose: Explain wire timing with the current Fedwire schedule and consumer rights.
research_brief.audience: Consumers and small businesses sending urgent payments.
research_brief.data_period: Fedwire schedule and CFPB pages checked October 26, 2026; Nacha Q3 2026 data.
research_brief.scope_limitations: U.S. focus; bank cutoffs and international ranges vary by provider.

sources.title: Fedwire Funds Service and National Settlement Service Operating Hours
sources.scope: Fedwire business day, cutoffs, non-business days
sources.limitations: Network hours only; bank cutoffs differ
sources.verification_note: Business day 9:00 p.m. ET preceding day to 7:00 p.m. ET; 6:45 p.m. ET core customer transfer cutoff; Saturdays, Sundays and holidays are non-business days (quoted).

sources.title: Fedwire Funds Service
sources.verification_note: All successfully processed messages contain IMAD and OMAD identifications (quoted).

sources.title: Fedwire Funds Service Business Continuity Guide
sources.verification_note: RTGS owned and operated by the Reserve Banks; payments final and irrevocable once made (quoted).

sources.title: Federal Reserve announces expanded operating days for Fedwire and NSS
sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
sources.verification_note: Expansion to include Sundays and weekday holidays, no earlier than 2028 (quoted).

sources.title: Can I cancel an international money transfer?
sources.verification_note: 30 minutes after payment if not picked up or deposited and provider can identify it; scheduled transfers up to three business days before (quoted).

sources.title: What is a remittance transfer and what are my rights?
sources.verification_note: 180 days from disclosed availability date to report errors; providers generally have 90 days to investigate; refund or resend possible (quoted).

sources.title: How ACH Payments Work
sources.verification_note: Nacha estimates 80% of all ACH payments settle in one banking day or less (quoted).

sources.title: Same Day ACH Growth Propels ACH Network Forward in Third Quarter 2026
sources.verification_note: Same Day ACH 470.4 million payments in Q3 2026, up 36.7% (quoted).

sources.title: How Long Does a Wire Transfer Take?
sources.verification_note: Domestic wires usually within 24 hours; international may take up to 5 business days (quoted).

statistics.claim: Same Day ACH handled 470.4 million payments in Q3 2026, up 36.7% year over year.

content_gaps: Few pages cite the current Fedwire operating hours.
Few mention the planned six-day schedule and its 2028 earliest date.
Few separate domestic finality from remittance cancellation rights.
value_add: Fedwire hours and cutoff quoted from the operator, the planned expansion dated, CFPB cancellation and error rights, and a Friday and holiday timing walkthrough.
